name: Mystical Butterfly
source:
She’s been alone since birth; alone in a world where no one will accept a half youkai, half kami. Life is difficult, and her only hope lies in her pendant.

That is until one day, everything changes. She is brought into the world of gods by the one known as Amaterasu-omikami. In the beginning, again, no one accepts her; but as time goes on, she gradually finds friends and a family.

Your journey begins as you are traveling between the world of the gods, and the human world in the Edo Era. Together with the four sacred beasts, you will find out the truth about your origins. Perhaps you will even find love and happiness…

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/73118837199/mystical-butterfly-release-dates-android]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
她从出生起就一直孤身一人。独自生活在一个没有人会接受一半妖怪、一半神明的世界里。生活很艰难，她唯一的希望就在她的吊坠上。

直到有一天，一切都改变了。被天照大神带入神的世界。一开始，同样没有人接受她；但随着时间的推移，她逐渐找到了朋友和家人。

你的旅程开始于江户时代的神界与人界之间。与四圣兽一起，你将查明自己的来历真相。也许你甚至会找到爱和幸福……

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/73118837199/mystical-butterfly-release-dates-android]英语乙女游戏[/url]]
